subject: BigBird pilot quota & roadmap coordination
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma.li@horizoncommerce.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BigBird pilot: quota ask and preflight plan

Team — quick kickoff for Horizon Commerce (BigBird pilot). Emma looped in — they want to go live with a controlled pilot the week of 2026-07-12. High-level asks below and a proposed timeline in the attached capacity_plan.xlsx. SLA draft attached.

Ask summary:
- Quota bump: start with a sustained 12k tokens/sec cap (burst to 36k for 5 min windows) for first 72 hours, then reassess.
- Routing: prefer US-west region; fallback to us-east only if latency >= 300ms or we hit node failures.
- Model variants: use bigbird-13B-quant (default), fallback to bigbird-13B-fp16 if we observe quality regressions.
- Telemetry: enable token-level tracing + prefix cache logs for the pilot so Horizon can validate latency/cost.

Constraints/notes (ops/product):
- We need confirm from Capacity if we can reserve Dedicated slots for the pilot window or a guaranteed burst SLA.
- Product: can we lock the model variant mapping in infra config so rollbacks don't flip their endpoint?

Next steps (proposal):
1) Ops (Neha) verifies capacity & provides a reservation window and estimated cost delta by end-of-day Tue (6/30).
2) Product (Laura) to confirm model pinning mechanism and any migration effort by Wed (7/1).
3) Sales/Account (me) to confirm go/no-go with Horizon after ops/product confirm; finalize SLA doc.

Attachments: capacity_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), SLA-DRAFT-v2.pdf

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Emma Li <emma.li@horizoncommerce.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BigBird pilot: quota ask and preflight plan

Thanks Vivek — copied quick product notes inline.

- Model pinning: we can pin at route-level for the pilot. It requires a short config change in the control plane (no code deploy). If we need auto-fallback to the other variant, that will be a feature toggle; for this pilot, I recommend we do an explicit failover policy (manual in the first 24 hrs) to avoid unintended quality flips.

- Telemetry: OK to enable token-level tracing for the pilot; ensure we redact PII in traces (ops).

- If we expect Horizon to hit the burst for heavy embeddings batches, we should also recommend they use batched embed endpoints which are cheaper — include that in the playbook.

I'll review the SLA draft and propose comments by Tue morning.

Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BigBird pilot: quota ask and preflight plan

Thanks all — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifications from Horizon's side: 

1) Traffic profile (estimated):
- Peak: ~28k tokens/sec for 10-minute windows during daytime activation (marketing push)
- Sustained: ~8–10k tokens/sec steady state outside peak
- Embeddings: batched, approx 500 requests/minute with 256 vectors each (we'll use the batched embed endpoint)

2) Pilot timeline: we were hoping to start seeding traffic on 2026-07-13 (soft) and do the full pilot 2026-07-15 to 2026-07-22. We can be flexible if ops needs the earlier window.

3) Fallback: if a fallback to fp16 is required, we ask for a short test run (10–15 mins) before fully switching to ensure output parity.

4) Access: can we get a shared read-only dashboard for the first 72 hrs to see latency by route? If so we can correlate to our client-side metrics.

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BigBird pilot: quota ask and preflight plan

Quick ops update and next steps — I've run the initial binpack and capacity math against our US-west pools. Short answer: we can support the proposed window with a Dedicated reservation and a short burst SLA, but cost delta is non-trivial (see attached capacity_plan.xlsx estimates).

Concrete items:
- Reservation: can reserve 4x p3-equivalent slots between 2026-07-12 00:00 UTC and 2026-07-20 00:00 UTC. That supports peak bursts to ~38k tokens/sec with our batching profile.
- Automated throttles: we'll configure a soft throttle at 36k and a hard throttle at 42k. If soft throttle hits, we'll notify the account and flip limited traffic to the fallback region.
- Read-only dashboard: we can provision a shared Grafana dashboard (read-only link) for Horizon for the pilot first 72 hrs. I will share link once the infra change is scheduled.
- Cost delta: estimated incremental monthly spend for the pilot window ~ $28k (one-time pulse). Exact numbers in capacity_plan.xlsx.

Next steps:
1) Ops schedules the reservation (I can slot it if you confirm by EOD Wed 7/1).
2) Product to confirm the manual failover process & add runbook steps (Laura).
3) Sales and Horizon sign the updated SLA (Vivek/Emma) — doc in Drive; suggested edits from Laura expected Tue morning.
